title: zea mays var. aestiva
intro: Zea mays var. aestiva, commonly known as sweet corn, is a variant of the corn plant that is specifically cultivated for its edible kernels. The health benefits of sweet corn include being a rich source of fiber, vitamins, and minerals, which can help in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting healthy blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of sweet corn include its potential to reduce symptoms of anxiety and depression, improve cognitive function, and provide antioxidant effects due to its rich content of phytochemicals. The bioactive constituents of sweet corn include vitamin C, vitamin E, beta-carotene, ferulic acid, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
